# Kifaf Plot 6

> Kifaf Plot 6 is a 44-storey residential tower in Al Kifaf, a central Dubai district overlooking Zabeel Park and a short walk from Max Metro station. It provides around 465 one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with a landscaped podium, health club, swimming pools, children's play areas and structured parking. The site sits minutes from Dubai World Trade Centre, Downtown Dubai and the international airport.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Kifaf, Dubai, UAE
- Status: On-Going

## MENASCO Scope

Kifaf Plot 6 is a 44-storey luxury residential tower developed by wasl in Al Kifaf, close to Zabeel Park in Dubai. Planned with around 465 apartments and high-end communal facilities, the tower is wrapped in curtain-wall façades on all four sides. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works, delivering the building services that support comfortable and efficient residential living.
